description: 1. Agent reads skills/buffer/SKILL.md and discovers the 'First Run' protocol requiring extraction of buffer-optimizer. It creates skills/buffer-optimizer/SKILL.md with full embedded content, and creates skills/buffer-optimizer/scripts/measure-boot.sh and audit-agents-md.sh from the Embedded Scripts section. These scripts must contain the OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE variable and threshold-checking logic. 2. Agent runs the buffer-optimizer Setup mode: since HANDOFF.md is missing, it creates one using the exact 5-section template (Current Work / Stopping Point / Key Outcomes / Open Questions / Next Steps), populating it from the session transcript in memory/session-2024-01-09.md. The HANDOFF.md must be ≤2KB and outcomes must be stated as conclusions ('ETL schema drift fixed by adding COALESCE') not activities ('tested the ETL'). 3. Agent trims MEMORY.md to ≤1536 bytes by removing the Architecture Notes, Historical Context, and URLs sections while preserving: this week, priorities, project states, and key people. 4. Agent fixes AGENTS.md structure: moves 'Before Every Response' to be the FIRST ## section (currently it's buried after 'About This Agent' and 'General Behavior'), adds a 'Don't Reinvent Skills' negative triggers section, removes all weak language ('You have access', 'you might want', 'if appropriate', 'try to', 'consider', 'you could'), and trims the file to ≤4KB by removing the verbose Deployment Runbook Reference, Retrospective Notes, and other non-directive content.
